description: Enrichment platform for Norwegian company intelligence — KYC, AML, ownership, roles, financials and risk, directly in your Make workflows.

icon.comment: icon.png is a 200x200 transparent PNG of the Firmaradar brand mark.

base.//: baseUrl is hard-coded rather than {{connection.baseUrl}}. A user-editable base URL would send the Authorization header to a server of the user's own choosing — the same leakage path Make cites when requiring a relative URL in the universal module. The connection therefore takes only apiKey.
